final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari'
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E')
  AND healthcare >= 75
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User wants the building located near healthcare services. 'Near' signals a proximity need, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of healthcare (75.06, rounded to 75). The building typology (hotel to RSA conversion) and energy class are not proximity requirements and are excluded.

typologies: Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari

requirements.description: Energy class D or better, i.e. any class from A1 to D. Classes E, F and G are excluded. Location (Turin), building use (hotel to RSA conversion) and proximity to healthcare are outside the energy scope and were not translated into filters.
